heroReason: R1 uniquely separates the dark core, thin bright ring, front band, both arches and disk striations in a full-object crop. R4 is larger but its ring is obscured by bloom.
method: Pillow, NumPy and SciPy on original-resolution images, with documented visual estimates where the inverse geometry is ambiguous. Coded output is not a pixel-derived texture.

M1.method: Darkest central region threshold, excluding the foreground band; widest horizontal run above band.

M2.method: Circle-centre estimate checked at enlarged ring crop. Threshold centroid is biased by the foreground band.

M5.method: Brightest smoothed centre column within ±0.3 shadow radii.

M6.method: Brightest line in smoothed upper-arch column; multi-striation peak ambiguity.

M7.method: Lower-column maximum and upper/lower luminance ratio.

M8.method: FWHM of isolated ring peak above the shadow; 3x3 smoothing.

M10.method: Image borders crop both ends; only lower bounds can be stated.

M11.method: Least-squares power-law fit on right band at 1.65–2.5 radii; cropped, noisy and graded.

M12.method: Mean luminance of symmetric band intervals 1.5–2.1 radii.

M17.method: Luminance percentiles excluding white frame in qualitative interpretation.

M3.method: Thin central ring nearly circular. Outer dark gap is asymmetric, not identified as the shadow boundary.

M4.method: Visual inference from thin primary band, near-equal arches. Cannot uniquely recover inclination from a graded image.

M9.method: Enlarged near-horizontal ring/inner-disk edges; strong asymmetric gap indicates rotating-hole geometry or perspective.

M15.method: Upper halo smoothed column reaches 10% around 24 pixels beyond outer bright region; no clear long isolated anamorphic streak.

conflicts.issue: R1 gap and outer arches offset relative to nearly circular inner ring. Schwarzschild is symmetric.
conflicts.decision: Retain the near-circular shadow, fit a small arch offset in the procedural low-cost display model; label rotating-hole differences and GPU limitations.

conflicts.issue: R3 cool/lavender exposure differs from R1 warm cream and brown.
conflicts.decision: Warm R1 is shipped default; a cool lab preset only. No purple gradient UI.

conflicts.issue: R2/R4 screen-plane tilt differs from R1 near-horizontal band.
conflicts.decision: Independent display rotation parameter and lab preset, without changing physical inclination.

conflicts.issue: R1 front band crosses the dark core and R1 disk extent is cropped.
conflicts.decision: Exclude genuine foreground-band pixels from shadow-blackness test. Report M10 as a lower bound, not a false exact match.
